prompt: How old was the Commander-in-Chief of India from 1865-1870 when he died? How old was his wife when she died? Average these two numbers, rounding up to the nearest whole integer if necessary.
answer:
The Commander-in-Chief of India from 1865 to 1870 was **Sir William Mansfield, 1st Baron Sandhurst**, who died aged **57**.

His wife, **Margaret, Lady Sandhurst**, died aged **64**.

Average: \((57 + 64) / 2 = 60.5\), which rounds up to **61 years**.
